title: Create TapIn content pages (privacy, terms, support, _index)
description: content/tapin/privacy.md: privacy policy for TapIn. content/tapin/terms.md: terms of service. content/tapin/support.md: support/contact with email. content/tapin/_index.md: TapIn section landing. Each with front matter: title, date, lastmod, description.

title: Create minimal layouts (baseof, single, list, index) with Pico.css
description: baseof.html: HTML5 skeleton with Pico.css CDN link. single.html: renders title, lastmod, content. list.html: app section index listing child pages. index.html: home page listing all apps.

title: Add Cloudflare Pages configuration
description: Document Cloudflare Pages build settings: build command=hugo, output directory=public, HUGO_VERSION env var. Configured in Cloudflare dashboard, no wrangler.toml needed.

title: Create Docker setup (Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml)
description: Dockerfile using hugomods/hugo:exts for dev server. docker-compose.yml mounting project to /src, exposing port 1313, with --bind 0.0.0.0 and --disableFastRender.

title: Test locally with docker compose
description: Run docker compose up. Verify all pages render at localhost:1313. Check URL paths: /tapin/privacy/, /tapin/terms/, /tapin/support/. Verify Pico.css styling loads. Check hugo build completes without errors.

title: Scaffold Hugo project (hugo.toml, directory structure)
description: Create hugo.toml with baseURL=https://apps.flurdy.io, title, params. Create directory structure: content/tapin/, layouts/_default/, static/images/. Add Hugo ignores to .gitignore (public/, resources/, .hugo_build.lock).
